presetsLabel.description: Accessible name for the preset group.

composerMaxHeight.description: Maximum composer height before it scrolls.

composerNative.description: Restore the composer height without changing other settings.

heightNative.description: Shown when a height control is left to the page.

breakout.description: Allow code, tables and images to escape the reading column.

lineHeight.description: Line height slider. Stored as tenths.

statusSaving.description: Status while a write is in flight.

statusError.description: Status when storage rejects the write.

statusStorage.description: Status when chrome.storage cannot be read.
